# Review result

Both assigned targets are **ready as reviewer-built native parametric artifacts**. Neither is owner-accepted or training-admitted; the owner must integrate the exact source, rerun native qualification, replay the witness, and accept both separately.

## 8a851bf5cdd7

Canonical source was repaired rather than merely wrapping the old defects. The invalid `no_separator` branch and ignored controls were removed; `variant=0..2` is now structural; ragged input is handled; and every ordinary draw makes both additions and deletions visibly affect panel C. The strongest cheap bypasses—addition-only and deletion-only—failed on all 96 bounded ordinary draws.

The existing forward/reverse parametric family remains the main artifact. Forward is byte-identical to the canonical Racket rule. Its bounded probe passed 20/20 episodes, 160 independent-oracle comparisons, 8 boundary labels, 1,116 protected-Racket applications, and 4 native-worker jobs. Exact 30×30 is impossible for the three-panel grammar (`3w+2`); the family reaches 30×29 with substantive content.

Fresh authoring preflight passed 4 jobs / 2 settings / 24 parametric pairs / 3 canonical pairs / 32 protected-Racket evaluations. The causal witness derives a signed edit stencil from the first two panels and applies it to C; reversing that intermediate changes the executed label.

## 7cda20c438b7

Canonical source now exposes only real dimension/count controls, rejects ignored or identity-producing degenerates, and generates spacing-2 center chains with shared arms. This closes the prior isolated-X teaching hole. The isolated-only shortcut failed on all 96 bounded ordinary draws, and all 24 declared override combinations were observed exactly.

The diagonal/orthogonal family passed 20/20 episodes, 882 protected-Racket applications, and 4 native-worker jobs. It supports 2–6 demonstrations, four distinct queries, and substantive 30×30 cases. Fresh authoring preflight passed 4 jobs / 2 settings / 24 parametric pairs / 4 canonical pairs / 32 protected-Racket evaluations. Its causal witness uses an orthogonal two-center case with a shared arm; substituting the diagonal-derived center set changes the executed label.

## Downstream checks

Packet-native target suites passed **31/31** and **27/27**. Each fresh projection produced 16 independent one-query public views. For each target, verification checked 4

previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h~7-9, w~7-10) with 2-3 COLOR-3 (green) DIAGONAL X-PATTERNS marking centers. Each X has 4 diagonal arm cells at (r-1, c-1), (r-1, c+1), (r+1, c-1), (r+1, c+1) all painted COLOR 3 (green). The center cell (r, c) stays 0 (black). Centers are at least Chebyshev distance 3 apart so Xs don't overlap. Rule (FILL X CENTERS WITH YELLOW): for EACH 5-CELL X-PATTERN (center cell at (r, c) with all 4 diagonal neighbors COLOR 3), PAINT the CENTER CELL with COLOR 4 (yellow). The 4 green arms stay. Net: each green-diagonal X gets a yellow dot center.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent valid-center coordinate set, together with any arm cells shared by multiple selected centers.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Scan interior zero cells with the selected neighborhood offsets and return the coordinates whose four required neighbors are color 3, including overlap relations between their arms.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint exactly the centers supplied by Step A color 4 while preserving every non-center cell.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Grid size and fixed positions do not determine the paint targets. Step B consumes the center set from Step A; substituting diagonal offsets for the selected orthogonal offsets produces the wrong center set and a different protected-Racket output.
